name: Atharv Enterprises Limited
about: Atharv Enterprises Limited manufactures and sells textile and synthetic fabrics in India. The company offers polyester viscose, polyester cotton, polyester, and cotton fabrics. The company was formerly known as Jaju Enterprises Ltd and changed its name to Atharv Enterprises Limited in February 2006. Atharv Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Mumbai, India.
